A search needs a case number, a case title, a bankruptcy chapter or a date range. PACER bills $0.10 for each page of up to 54 results, even when nothing matches, with no cap on search fees; it waives a quarter's fees when they come to $30 or less. Searches in PACER's QA test environment are free.

description: Search the PACER Case Locator, the national index of U.S. federal court cases: find cases and parties across every district, bankruptcy and appeals court, run large batch searches, and start a workflow when a new case is filed for a party or matching a search. Needs a PACER account; PACER bills searches by the page.
